summary: The filing is a Form 6-K attaching the notice and proxy statement for Euroholdings Ltd.'s 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The meeting will consider routine proposals: election of two Class B directors and ratification of Deloitte as independent auditors. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is implicated. The filing constitutes a routine annual meeting notice rather than a corporate action requiring special-situations classification.
